messages:
alex: quick heads-up — seeing a 3x p95 latency spike on serving nodes under long-context workloads. profiler points to the KV eviction + redispatch path as the dominant cost (pager wakeups + redispatch hot loop). snippet from perf sampling:

```
[perf-sample] top stacks (10s):
  evicter::evict_entry() ........ 34.2%  // holds evict_lock, scans slab
  pager::reclaim_page() ........ 22.5%  // wakes pager, performs free
  scheduler::redispatch_to_worker() 18.0% // context switch churn
  kv::get_sparse() ............. 12.1%  // lookup + potential reinserts
  sync::mutex_contended_wait() . 9.4%   // lock thrash
```

alex: quick notes: pattern happens under FIFO eviction mode with high reuse churn and fragmented slabs. FIFO reinserts are creating long reinsert chains that trigger repeated pager activity; redispatchs from the evicter thread to workers cause blocking and increased latency variance. posting here to triage and decide short-term mitigation.

maya: can you attach the flamegraph or a tiny repro? we need something we can run locally.

alex: small repro lives in /dev/shm/kv-repro; run `./run_repro.sh --long-context 64 --mix read-heavy --burst 200`. output shows steady p95 gap during the burst window.

pranav: initial read: evicter holds a global "evict_lock" while scanning + doing free() which can trigger scheduler redispatches when the free path blocks on kernel or allocator. combined with FIFO reinserts you get a cascade. two ideas: 1) make free path async (defer to background thread) 2) move to per-shard evicter to reduce contention. also suspect batching heuristics: small batch sizes increase KV lookup frequency which amplifies evictions.

jen: saw a canary yesterday where we blamed kernel-selection fallbacks; might be related. can we flip one shard to LRU and compare? LRU should reduce reinserts for hot keys.

alex: did a quick toggle on shard-7 from FIFO -> LRU for 10m: p95 dropped ~40% for that shard, but CPU for evicter thread rose ~10% (more CPU but less latency variance). ascii mini-graph from our dashboard:
```
shard-7 p95:  ────■■■
shard-8 p95:  ─────────■■■■
```
(not pretty, but shows delta)

ops-bot: deploy: applied config change `kv.eviction.policy=lru` to shard-7 for experiment :white_check_mark:

maya: cool. can we schedule a 30m sync to decide next steps if LRU holds? @pranav can you own a patch to move frees off the hot path (async free queue)? I'll own telemetry + add eviction-specific spans.

pranav: on it. I'll prototype an async-free queue + per-shard evict loop. plan: keep logic identical but hand off actual memory frees to background worker (reduce redispatch and kernel hold). aiming for a PR by EOD.

alex: created INF-1209 with links to repro and perf captures. added logs for evicter lock hold times and reinsert chain lengths. thanks all.

jen: fyi i'll validate kernel-selection interactions after the evict patch — want to rule out that fallback/pathologic kernels are compounding the issue.

alex: great. if LRU shows stable p95 across longer runs we can consider making it a config default for long-context pools and follow up with the async-free work.

maya: assigning sync: 30m at 15:00 UTC. agenda: confirm LRU experiment, repro walk, PR review for async-free.

pranav: putting draft branch up now: github.com/redwood-inference/evicter/compare/async-free-prototype (WIP).

ops-bot: ticket INF-1209 created and linked to this thread :ticket: "kv eviction redispatch latency under FIFO"

alex: thanks — leaving logs and perf links in the ticket. we'll converge here after the sync. :thumbsup:
